mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, directly increasing S&P 500 valuations and producing positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100) indicates manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate output capacity and profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations for positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A non-farm payrolls decline below 135,000 thousand persons indicates labor market weakness that reduces household income and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is below 135000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad economic slowdown that reduces corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO above 100) indicates manufacturing sector strength that boosts corporate output and profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.05.
